communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

Unless stated otherwise, this request covers records created, sent, received or in effect between January 1, 2020, and the date this request is processed.

Definition: "Social media monitoring software" means any software, platform, subscription or service used to search, collect, monitor, analyze, alert on or retain information from social media services (for example Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Snapchat, Telegram or Discord). This includes, but is not limited to, products from: BrightPlanet, Babel Street, Cobwebs Technologies / Penlink (Tangles), Dataminr (First Alert), Fivecast, Geofeedia, Intrado, LifeRaft (Navigator), Magnet Forensics, Media Sonar, ShadowDragon, Signal Corporation, Skopenow, Social Links, Voyager Labs and ZeroFOX.

Because Magnet products are also used for phone and computer forensics, for Magnet Forensics this request covers only items 1, 2, 4 and 6 (procurement, product, policy and training records). I am not requesting case files, extraction reports or examination records for any device or individual.

1.  Procurement and payment. All contracts, agreements, quotes, purchase orders, invoices, subscription or license renewals, P-card or credit card transactions, and grant applications or awards (including any federal grant funds) for social media monitoring software.
2.  How the software works. Product descriptions, user manuals, capability statements, technical specifications and vendor presentations for any social media monitoring software APD uses or has used.
3.  Vendor communications. Emails and attachments between the vendors named above and whoever currently holds the following positions: the commanding officer of APD's Critical Intelligence Center (and any analysts assigned to it), the City IT staff responsible for APD technology projects (project manager and Deputy CIO), and the purchasing or grants staff who process APD technology purchases, that contain at least one of these terms: "contract", "quote", "invoice", "renewal", "pilot", "trial", "demo", "license" or "subscription". Please exclude automated marketing emails, newsletters, webinar invitations and any message containing the word "unsubscribe".
4.  Policies. All general orders, directives, SOPs, policies or guidelines that govern the use of social media monitoring software, including rules on authorization, permitted purposes, data retention and audits.
5.  Officer and undercover accounts. All policies, general orders or guidelines that govern APD personnel using personal, fictitious, alias or "undercover" social media accounts for investigative or intelligence purposes, and any approval forms or logs used to authorize such accounts.
6.  Training. All training materials, presentations and course records used to teach APD personnel how to use social media monitoring software or how to collect information from social media.
7.  Outside sharing. All agreements, MOUs, policies or logs that cover sharing information obtained through social media monitoring software with entities outside APD (including other law enforcement agencies, fusion centers and federal agencies).
8.  Configuration and audit records. Saved search terms, keyword lists, watchlist names or categories, geofence locations, alert settings, and any usage, audit or compliance reports for social media monitoring software. I am not requesting the social media content of any individual, and the City may redact names and personal identifiers under Section 7(1)(c).

Please provide records electronically (PDF, or native format for spreadsheets and logs) by email. If no responsive records exist for an item, please say so for that item.

If any part of these records is withheld or redacted, please cite the specific exemption under 5 ILCS 140/7 for each redaction and release all reasonably segregable, non-exempt portions.

If you believe any item is unduly burdensome, I ask that you contact me under Section 3(g) so we can narrow it before any denial.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. 

Sincerely,

M
